name: Push Notifications
description: Remote notifications: the APNs / FCM token, the permission prompt, the registration at the le.codes relay, the routing of a tap and of a foreground message. The app's side is Push. Delivery is scoped to apps published by Letary (iOS: com.letary.* bundle ids under the team's APNs key; Android: packages of the le.codes Firebase project, by google-services.json).
